data.long_meaning: One who is graceful, delicate, and has a beautiful character. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Arwaat usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the beauty and grace of Allah's creation.
data.etymology: Arwaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arwaat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عروات
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من عروة، يعني القوة و الثبات
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عروات هو اسم مؤنث مشتق من عروة، ويعني القوة و الثبات. يعود أصل الاسم إلى الجذر العربي (ع-ر-و) الذي يحمل معاني الصبر و الثبات. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليشير إلى الفتاة التي تتميز بالقوة و الصبر.

in_urdu.name: عروات
in_urdu.meaning: عروات نام کا مطلب ہے قوت، ثبات اور صبر
in_urdu.long_meaning: عروات ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے جذر (ع-ر-و) سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے قوت، ثبات اور صبر۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام ان فاطمات کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو قوت، صبر اور ثبات کی مالک ہوتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: अरवा
in_hindi.meaning: अरवा नाम का अर्थ है शक्ति, स्थिरता और धैर्य
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरवा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के मूल (अ-र-व) से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है शक्ति, स्थिरता और धैर्य। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन लड़कियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो शक्ति, धैर्य और स्थिरता की विशेषता रखती हैं।

in_pashto.name: عروات
in_pashto.meaning: عروات نوم معنی یې د قوت، ثبات او صبر څخه عبارت دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عروات د ښځینه نوم دی چی د عربی ژبی له ريښی (ع-ر-و) څخه اخیستل شوی دی. ددی نوم معنی د قوت، ثبات او صبر څخه عبارت دی. د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو کړاو کې، دا نوم د هغو نجلونو لپاره کارول کیږي چی د قوت، صبر او ثبات ځانګړتیاوې لري.

in_english.name: Arwaat
in_english.meaning: A female given name meaning strength, stability, and patience
in_english.long_meaning: Arwaat is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic root (ع-ر-و), conveying meanings of strength, stability, and patience. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies a person with resilient and steadfast qualities. Etymologically linked to the Quranic concept of 'urwah (عروة), meaning 'stronghold' or 'support', the name Arwaat symbolizes spiritual and moral fortitude. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote girls with admirable character traits.

The name Arwaat is reminiscent of the importance placed on graciousness and refinement in Islamic society. It represents a gentle and delicate soul that exudes class and poise.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Arwaat suggests an inner beauty and grace that goes beyond physical appearance. It alludes to the virtue of good character and kindness, which are considered essential for a righteous and God-conscious life. The spiritual significance of the name Arwaat lies in its reminder to strive for inner beauty, good character, and kind actions, as these qualities will not only benefit the individual in this life but also in the hereafter.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Arwaat bint Imru'l-Qais was a legendary female warrior in pre-Islamic Arabian poetry. The name Arwaat carried significant weight in that era.
